identity.title: Spider-Boy
identity.variant: Humberto Ramos Cover A - First Printing

evidence.notes: Individually inspected owned front Raw_15-056_FRONT.jpg. Ramos building-side artwork, movie banner and printed UPC 75960620785500111 match Spider-Boy #1 Cover A. Retailer URL is misleadingly named #2, but its rendered heading and UPC are #1. GCD series 205262 barcode catalog also confirms first printing. Printed artist mark is part of the cover, not a separately authenticated autograph. Condition remains unassessed.

Artwork matches Moon Man #2 Ivan Tao Rabbit Comics OBJ The Catch virgin, also identified by listing 176404709294. The Moon Man #1 Jumpman spread-leg pose is different. No UPC or condition inferred.
